description: Login issues session tokens and returns configured response fields.

cases.description: A valid credential exchange creates one persisted session token and returns a successful HTTP response with an expiry timestamp.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="2020-01-01T10:00:00Z"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: Repeated valid credential exchanges create independent persisted session tokens.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="2020-01-01T10:00:00Z"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
token_count=5
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: When account profile output is enabled, the login response includes the authenticated account identifier as a nested user object.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="2020-01-01T10:00:00Z"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
login.user_fields=username
login.user.username=john.doe
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: When a custom expiry display format is configured, the login response renders the expiry timestamp using that format.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="10:00 01/01/20"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: When sessions are configured not to expire, the login response still includes the expiry field with a null value.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry=null
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: When an issued-token prefix is configured, a newly issued session token includes that prefix and remains persisted.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="2020-01-01T10:00:00Z"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=TEST_
login.token_length=69
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true
